$comment: Part of the measured image: changing it changes the image digest, which partners see and Mynt announces 48 hours ahead. callers: by client certificate common name. sign: the keys a caller may have sign a message it hands over (sealed: a private key Mynt stored sealed here); the health-attester key is never among them, whatever this file says (keyhouse.mjs RESERVED_SIGNING_KEYS): it signs only the report the health check computed. public_key: the named keys whose public half a caller may read. purposes: whether what's sealed for each may ever come back out (core/src/confidential/host.ts PURPOSES must agree: test/confidential.test.js checks).
